en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate neoclassical interior hall with high coffered ceilings, grand arches, columns, elaborate chandeliers, rows of chairs along the walls, and a central statue in a niche. The left side features the photograph labeled at the bottom, while the right side contains dense handwritten text in German script. The word "Graz" appears at the top right in red, and at the bottom center is printed "Universität, Aula."
